Question: The perspective that development is embedded in history means that

Options: 
A. Only physical development is influenced by age
B. Some characteristics change with age while others do not
C. All individuals experience development at the same pace
D. Development is dependent solely on genetic factors
E. Developmental changes are always positive
F. Sociocultural conditions must always be considered
G. Development in any particular areas (e.g., social) is tied to development in other areas (e.g., cognitive)
H. Development is unaffected by external influences
I. Change can always occur regardless of age
J. History has no impact on individual development

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
